mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies and 66 degrees by the Verona Public Library. With the third quarter moon, keep an eye out for the space station passing over at 5:13 AM as it travels from Mount Horeb toward Belleville.

The city has shared a few updates. The Verona Police Department arrested a Madison resident on September 4 for a 2019 incident involving the sexual assault of a child by a school staff member. Additionally, road work continues near the Aldi development on Highway M, and the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is underway, with a major closure scheduled between Lincoln and South Franklin Streets from mid-September through mid-November.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, join a class at Insight Wellness. On Monday, September 8, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee trivia nights. Then on Tuesday, September 9, enjoy the Farmers Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at Paddy Mac's, more music at Paddy Mac's, and trivia night at The Mill in Paoli.
On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Area School District alerted police to an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student from 2019, resulting in a recent arrest.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so head on over to start your day with a sweet treat.
